title: Meera Devi v. Sunil Mehra
text: This is a petition for dissolution of marriage under Section 13 HMA on the ground of irretrievable breakdown of marriage and desertion. The parties married in 2010 and the respondent-husband deserted the petitioner in 2015 without reasonable excuse. Despite efforts at reconciliation, including court- appointed mediation, the parties could not reunite. The court considers the concept of irretrievable breakdown as recognised by the Supreme Court. The parties have been living apart for over six years. The marriage has become a mere legal fiction with no prospect of resumption of cohabitation. The court grants divorce under Section 13 HMA. The wife is awarded monthly maintenance of Rs 20,000. The matrimonial home shall be shared between the parties as per mutual consent arrived at before the court. The court also notes that mutual consent divorce under Section 13-B HMA would have been more appropriate given the settled positions.
